title: Wait Time Charges on Wayfare Rides
content:
Wait time on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** is the time the driver waited at the pickup point beyond the free wait. It is charged only on a completed trip, together with the fare; a trip whose system record does not show it completed carries no wait time charge.

## How the wait is measured

| Booking | The wait runs from | to | Free minutes |
|---|---|---|---|
| On-demand trip | the driver's arrival | pickup | the ride option's free wait for on-demand trips |
| Reserved trip | the later of the reserved pickup time and the driver's arrival | pickup | the ride option's reserved free wait, or its reserved airport free wait when the pickup is at an airport |

Billable minutes are the elapsed wait minus the free minutes, counted in whole elapsed minutes with partial minutes dropped. When there are no billable minutes, no wait time charge is written.

## The charge

The wait time charge is the billable minutes multiplied by the ride option's wait rate per minute, rounded half up to the cent. The busy-time multiplier and Wayfare Pass discounts never apply to wait time. The billable minutes are recorded on the charge.

## Worked cases (hypothetical times and figures)

| Case | Measured wait | Free minutes | Billable minutes | Charge at a hypothetical $0.50 per minute |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| On-demand; driver arrived 10:00:00, pickup 10:05:40 | 5 min 40 s | 2 | 3 (3 min 40 s, partial minute dropped) | $1.50 |
| On-demand; driver arrived 10:00:00, pickup 10:02:00 | 2 min 0 s | 2 | 0 | no charge written |
| Reserved, non-airport; reserved pickup 14:00, driver arrived 13:52, pickup 14:17:30 | 17 min 30 s (counted from 14:00) | 15 | 2 | $1.00 |
| Reserved, airport; reserved pickup 14:00, driver arrived 14:10, pickup 14:41:10 | 31 min 10 s (counted from 14:10) | 30 | 1 | $0.50 |

On a reserved trip, time the driver spends at the pickup point before the reserved pickup time is not wait time, because the wait starts at the later of the two moments.
